SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK CQL-08: CQL — Nullological Operators. Test these items: Coalesce, IsNull, IsFalse, IsTrue. For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 Developer's Guide §Nullological Operators — Coalesce: 'first non-null expression among two or more' (variadic, unbounded); Appendix B Coalesce<T>(arguments List<T>)
issues.root_cause: Artificial 2..5 scalar arity cap; spec defines no upper bound.
issues.resolution: Removed the artificial 2..5 scalar-arity cap: _translate_coalesce (expressions/_functions.py) now rejects only <2 scalar args; public UDF Coalesce (udf/logical.py) same. CQL 1.5 §Coalesce variadic, no upper bound.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 §Coalesce: arguments 'may be of any type, but ... implicitly castable to a common type'; Integer and String are not
issues.root_cause: Translator passes mixed static types straight to DuckDB COALESCE; binder acceptance is order-dependent.
issues.resolution: AST-level static type-family check in _translate_function_ref: Coalesce mixing String-family with Integer/Long/Decimal static operands raises TranslationError uniformly in both argument orders.

issues.evidence: IsTrue(1) / IsFalse('false') return false instead of a type error; pinned deliberately by test_cql_infix_is_true_false_rejects_sql_truthiness (never-null, no SQL truthiness).
issues.root_cause: Deliberate lenient runtime predicate; no null leak, no truthiness.

issues.spec_citation: CQL 1.5 §Nullological Operators defines only operator form 'is not null'; no IsNotNull function
issues.evidence: IsNotNull(1) → true via macro IsNotNull(x)=x IS NOT NULL. Harmless superset equivalent to 'is not null'; kept for translation-symmetry with IsNull.
